item.text:
**7B.2 Research Note**

Overall read: **mostly no**. I found a few limited corrections or procedural retreats, but the dominant 2024 pattern is denial, blame-shifting, continued repression of truth-tellers, and refusal to own or correct abuses.

| Claim-level item | Publisher | Date | URL | Short claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Iran reduces sentence of jailed journalists after clearing them of collaborating with US](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-reduces-sentence-of-jailed-journalists-after-clearing-them-of-collaborating-with-us-3660786) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-13 | https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-reduces-sentence-of-jailed-journalists-after-clearing-them-of-collaborating-with-us-3660786 | Mixed but weakly positive: a court dropped the “collaborating with the U.S.” charge against two journalists and reduced their sentences. But they still remained punished for reporting on Amini’s death, so this is partial correction, not real accountability. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| [Journalists Ordered to Serve Five Years in Prison in Iran](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/24/journalists-ordered-serve-five-years-prison-iran) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-10-24 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/24/journalists-ordered-serve-five-years-prison-iran | Strong negative evidence: Iran’s judiciary enforced prison sentences against journalists for reporting on Amini’s death and framed the case as “propaganda against the state.” This is direct punishment of truthful reporting. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| [Report on Media and Journalists Suppression in Iran; First Half of 2024](https://www.deffi.org/en/report-on-media-and-journalists-suppression-in-iran-first-half-of-2024-2/) | Defending Free Flow of Information Organization | 2024-07-16 | https://www.deffi.org/en/report-on-media-and-journalists-suppression-in-iran-first-half-of-2024-2/ | Strong negative background: the report documents 236 judicial and security confrontations with media and journalists in just the first half of 2024. That supports a pattern of hostile treatment toward truth-tellers rather than openness. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| [Iran: Two years after ‘Woman Life Freedom’ uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/) | Amnesty International | 2024-09-11 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/ | Strong negative evidence: Amnesty says there were no effective, impartial investigations into killings, torture, sexual violence, or disappearances, and relatives seeking truth and justice were harassed. This is denial and intimidation rather than admission of error. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| [Iran: Security Forces Rape, Torture, Detainees](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-04-22 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees | Strong negative evidence: HRW says security forces raped, tortured, and sexually assaulted detainees, especially among Kurdish, Baluch, Azeri, and other ethnic communities. The system did not correct abuse; it concealed and repeated it. | 7B.2, 6B.8 |
| [Iran leader Khamenei, rifle at his side, vows resistance against Israel](https://www.theprint.in/world/iran-leader-khamenei-rifle-at-his-side-vows-resistance-against-israel/2297444/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-10-04 | https://www.theprint.in/world/iran-leader-khamenei-rifle-at-his-side-vows-resistance-against-israel/2297444/ | Strong negative evidence: Khamenei called the missile strike “legitimate punishment,” said resistance would not back down, and blamed the U.S. and allies for covering Israeli predation. This is doubling down and blame-shifting, not correction. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| [Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/ | Limited positive evidence: Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan, which Reuters said appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest restraint/correction signal I found, but it was tactical and short-lived. | 7B.2 |
| [Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-12-14 | https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/ | Limited positive evidence: Iran said it would not obstruct UN watchdog inspections and would operate within safeguards. That is a procedural openness signal, but it is narrow, late, and does not show a broader pattern of owning mistakes. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |
| [IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087 | Strong negative evidence: Reuters said Iran barred many of the agency’s top enrichment experts and the IAEA Board demanded reversal. That undercuts any claim that Khamenei’s system was willing to correct misleading nuclear claims through transparent cooperation. | 7B.2, 7B.1 |

**Search gap**

I did not find a clean 2024 example of Khamenei personally admitting a mistake, retracting a false claim, or disciplining his own misinformation apparatus. The evidence instead shows:
- some narrow, tactical restraint,
- one limited correction for imprisoned journalists,
- and a much stronger pattern of blaming outsiders, defending coercive acts, and punishing people who reported inconvenient facts.

**Bottom line**

Best-supported judgment: **no, not habitually**. In 2024, the ruler’s pattern is much closer to **double down, blame others, and punish truth-tellers** than to honest correction.
